name: Empty Gesture
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level alchemist 2, bard 2, inquisitor 2, legendary ninja 2, magus 2, occultist 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and hide your movements behind an unmoving image of yourself. Until the beginning of your next turn, any action taken, with the exception of movement, does not provoke attacks of opportunity or other reactions.
